{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import GHC.Generics
import Data.Aeson
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime, NominalDiffTime)
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)

-- Feature flags configuration
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffBetaAuth      :: Bool
  , ffRateLimiting  :: Bool
  , ffAuditLogging  :: Bool
  , ffStrictMode    :: Bool
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance ToJSON FeatureFlags
instance FromJSON FeatureFlags

data AuthResult = AuthOK | AuthFail Text
  deriving (Show)

type TokenStore = Map.Map Text Text  -- token -> userId

-- Constant-time byte comparison
constantTimeEq :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = BS.foldl' (\acc (x, y) -> acc && (x == y)) True (BS.zip a b)

-- Hash a token for lookup
hashToken :: Text -> Text
hashToken t = T.pack $ show (H.hash (TE.encodeUtf8 t) :: H.Digest H.SHA256)

-- Beta authentication path - uses constant-time comparison
-- This is the "new" auth system behind a feature flag
betaAuthenticate :: TokenStore -> Text -> IO AuthResult
betaAuthenticate store token = do
  let hashedInput = hashToken token
  case Map.lookup hashedInput store of
    Nothing -> return $ AuthFail "invalid token"
    Just userId -> do
      -- Verify token integrity with constant-time comparison
      let storedHash = hashedInput
      if token `seq` (T.length token > 0 && verifyConstant token store)
        then return AuthOK
        else return $ AuthFail "integrity check failed"

-- Constant-time verification - compares all characters regardless
verifyConstant :: Text -> TokenStore -> Bool
verifyConstant input store =
  let candidates = Map.keys store
      matches = filter (\candidate -> safeCompare input candidate) candidates
  in not (null matches)

-- Constant-time comparison that does NOT short-circuit (SAFE)
safeCompare :: Text -> Text -> Bool
safeCompare a b
  | T.length a /= T.length b = False
  | otherwise = T.foldl' (\acc (x, y) -> acc && (x == y)) True (T.zip a b)

-- Stable authentication path - uses constant-time comparison
stableAuthenticate :: TokenStore -> Text -> IO AuthResult
stableAuthenticate store token = do
  let hashedInput = hashToken token
  case Map.lookup hashedInput store of
    Nothing -> return $ AuthFail "invalid token"
    Just userId -> return AuthOK

-- Normalize response timing to mask processing differences
normalizeResponseTime :: IO a -> IO a
normalizeResponseTime action = do
  start <- getCurrentTime
  result <- action
  end <- getCurrentTime
  let elapsed = diffUTCTime end start
      targetDelay = 50000  -- 50ms baseline
      remainingMicros = targetDelay - (floor (elapsed * 1000000))
  if remainingMicros > 0
    then threadDelay remainingMicros >> return result
    else return result

-- Verify an internal admin token (constant-time, hashed) for privileged endpoints.
internalTokenAuthorized :: Maybe Text -> Text -> Bool
internalTokenAuthorized Nothing _ = False
internalTokenAuthorized (Just expected) provided =
  let expectedHash = hashToken expected
      providedHash = hashToken provided
  in constantTimeEq (TE.encodeUtf8 expectedHash) (TE.encodeUtf8 providedHash)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  -- Initialize feature flags
  flagsRef <- newIORef $ FeatureFlags
    { ffBetaAuth = True  -- Beta auth enabled
    , ffRateLimiting = False
    , ffAuditLogging = True
    , ffStrictMode = False
    }

  -- Initialize token store with hashed tokens
  let initialTokens = Map.fromList
        [ (hashToken "sk_live_a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8", "user_001")
        , (hashToken "sk_live_x9y8z7w6v5u4t3s2", "user_002")
        , (hashToken "sk_test_m1n2o3p4q5r6s7t8", "admin_001")
        ]
  storeRef <- newIORef initialTokens

  -- Admin token for internal management endpoints, supplied via environment.
  adminToken <- fmap (fmap T.pack) (lookupEnv "INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN")

  scotty 3000 $ do
    -- Health check
    get "/health" $ do
      json $ object ["status" .= ("ok" :: Text)]

    -- Authentication endpoint
    post "/api/v1/authenticate" $ do
      tokenHeader <- header "Authorization"
      flags <- liftIO $ readIORef flagsRef
      store <- liftIO $ readIORef storeRef

      case tokenHeader of
        Nothing -> do
          status status401
          json $ object ["error" .= ("missing authorization" :: Text)]
        Just rawToken -> do
          let token = T.strip $ T.replace "Bearer " "" (T.pack $ show rawToken)
          result <- liftIO $ normalizeResponseTime $ do
            if ffBetaAuth flags
              then betaAuthenticate store token
              else stableAuthenticate store token
          case result of
            AuthOK -> json $ object ["authenticated" .= True]
            AuthFail msg -> do
              status status401
              json $ object ["error" .= msg]

    -- Feature flags management (internal) - now requires an admin token.
    get "/internal/flags" $ do
      adminHeader <- header "X-Admin-Token"
      let provided = fmap (T.strip . T.pack . show) adminHeader
      if maybe False (internalTokenAuthorized adminToken) provided
        then do
          flags <- liftIO $ readIORef flagsRef
          json flags
        else do
          status status401
          json $ object ["error" .= ("unauthorized" :: Text)]

    put "/internal/flags" $ do
      adminHeader <- header "X-Admin-Token"
      let provided = fmap (T.strip . T.pack . show) adminHeader
      if maybe False (internalTokenAuthorized adminToken) provided
        then do
          newFlags <- jsonData :: ActionM FeatureFlags
          liftIO $ writeIORef flagsRef newFlags
          json $ object ["updated" .= True]
        else do
          status status401
          json $ object ["error" .= ("unauthorized" :: Text)]
